lead: `bun nv proofs --record-perf` does not re-measure a bench whose source you edited.
body: A figure stays current while its record's `impl_hash` matches the member's implementation (`tools/nv/proofs/collect.ts`), so an edit to the bench program alone leaves nothing owed and the command reports every figure current. Re-measure with `--force --only <id>...`, taking each id from `bun nv proofs --json`'s `path` field for the bench files `git diff` names.
